blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala faces Chinese Taipei’s Joanna Garland for the first time in the Asian Games 2026 tennis women’s singles quarterfinals. Their match is tentatively scheduled for Wednesday at Nagoya City Higashiyama Park Tennis Center. No time or court assignment has been released as of posting. The top-seeded Filipino bet opened her gold-medal bid after routing Thailand’s Patcharin Cheapchandej, 6-1, 6-0, in a second-round match hit by a rain delay on Monday.
